capabilities: Copy selected text from read-only Canvas cards via the normal copy shortcut
Choose between Markdown, plain rendered text, and rich rendered text copy formats
Preserve rendered HTML formatting (bold, italics, links, lists) when copying
Support Canvas views opened in separate Obsidian windows
extras: Relies on Obsidian's internal Canvas readonly flag, which is not exposed in the public plugin API, so it may need updates if that field changes; cross-origin web-page cards are unsupported.
intentEvidence: copy highlighted text from Markdown and text cards while a Canvas is in read-only mode
problem: Obsidian's read-only Canvas mode blocks the normal copy shortcut, so selected text in cards cannot be copied.
summary: Canvas helper that copies highlighted text from Markdown and text cards while a Canvas is in read-only mode.
